33:def parse_message_entity(text: str, entity: MessageEntity) -> str:
34:    """Returns the text from a given :class:`telegram.MessageEntity`.
35:
36:    Args:
37:        text (:obj:`str`): The text to extract the entity from.
38:        entity (:class:`telegram.MessageEntity`): The entity to extract the text from.
39:
40:    Returns:
41:        :obj:`str`: The text of the given entity.
42:    """
43:    entity_text = text.encode(TextEncoding.UTF_16_LE)
44:    entity_text = entity_text[entity.offset * 2 : (entity.offset + entity.length) * 2]
45:

51:) -> dict[MessageEntity, str]:
52:    """
53:    Returns a :obj:`dict` that maps :class:`telegram.MessageEntity` to :obj:`str`.
54:    It contains entities filtered by their ``type`` attribute as
55:    the key, and the text that each entity belongs to as the value of the :obj:`dict`.
56:
57:    Args:
58:        text (:obj:`str`): The text to extract the entity from.
59:        entities (list[:class:`telegram.MessageEntity`]): The entities to extract the text from.
60:        types (list[:obj:`str`], optional): List of ``MessageEntity`` types as strings. If the
61:            ``type`` attribute of an entity is contained in this list, it will be returned.
62:            Defaults to :attr:`telegram.MessageEntity.ALL_TYPES`.

64:    Returns:
